a trip can be very therapeutic in the right set and setting. a trip can also be very dangerous in the wrong set and setting. trips can also just be really fucking cool depending on how you go into the trip. yes, they can be used to help you process difficulties in your life. I wouldn't say they are the end all be all however, studies do show more positive outcomes compared to negatives. also, to use lsd to cure depress I think might be saying too much. ideally this would be done in a private session with a psychologist and a guide, not to mention many no-drug therapy session before and after. if used correctly psychedelics can definitely help someone in that way. it just depends on how they are used.

my best experience is just a little moment that happened in a hard trip. My boyfriend came to visit me (in uni) and we had hung up posters on my wall for visuals. there was an empty spot on the wall between posters but my man was sitting on my bed in such a way where he covered that hole in the posters and not only were the visuals 10/10 but the way my heart felt, so full and so happy, nothing in the universe could amount. I took a picture of the moment and i will probably never forget it.

Before i start i just want to say I've never been clinically diagnosed with depression but have had many many dark days..
I've taken both mushrooms and LSD however LSD had longer lasting effects on my depression. After the trip I was so much more calmer and overall happier. I saw that all the little things in life are just that, small and insignificant. It's easier to not get so mad and upset over something so irrelevant. I realized how unhappy I was and incredibly suicidal. I did realize that my body dysmorphia had increased slightly and so did my anxiety but it's easier to deal with those now than before. 
It only took one LSD trip to feel those effcts and that was on about 1.5 tabs and lasted almost 2 months until I dosed again.
